about_the_game:
Leave no stone unturned with the Past Mistakes - Walkthrough & Cheats! Use in-game cheats to uncover unexplored routes and character interaction. Read the walkthrough, which covers every route and choice to tailor your playthrough.

  • In-game cheats to control variables, points and flags for character interaction, to open up unexplored routes.

  • A written walkthrough exploring all routes, branches and endings, giving you the knowledge to construct your playthrough how you like.

This game is currently in early access, meaning its content as well as all the DLC content will be updated regularly until the Act I is completed.
